integrity_statement: Analytical derivative and strict log-concavity argument supply the proof. Standalone CHECK.py runs 15,159 diagnostic assertions; finite tests do not independently establish the all-parameter theorem.
scientific_limitations: Continuously rescaled group size, deterministic hazard, saturating Hill attack encounter, one randomly targeted victim per successful attack and exponential conditional capture success are model assumptions.
No claim that all integer-valued group-size samples exhibit two extrema, that functional form is field-calibrated, or that the model predicts the evolutionarily optimal group size.
Full texts of Turner–Pitcher (1986) and Wrona–Dixon (1991) were not available; the compared primary publisher abstracts leave priority risk.
title: Sharp reentrant predation-risk threshold under saturating group attraction
